messages:
alice: Heads-up: noticed customer-reported dashboard showing org B's project list when logged into org A. Reproducible via console /projects view.
ben: that's bad. steps?
alice: login as alice@org-a -> open /org/ORG-A/projects -> results include projects with owner_id org-b123
carla: could be caching or our query middleware scoping bug. any telemetry traces?
dmitri: pulled a quick trace, looks like the internal API call is to /internal/projects?env=prod — missing X-Org header in the request when routed from the console. stacktrace:
```
fetch(/internal/projects) -> ServiceProxy -> forward(req) -> req.headers.drop('x-org')
```
eve: we intentionally strip some headers in the proxy for security, but x-org should be preserved. deploying config change a week ago touched that code.
ben: can you paste the proxy diff?
carla: diff:
```
- forwarded = pick(req.headers, ['authorization','content-type'])
+ forwarded = pick(req.headers, ['authorization','content-type'])
```
(no x-org)
alice: wow. so frontend sets X-Org but proxy doesn't forward -> backend falls back to user session which for some SA token was global.
dmitri: mitigation idea: add tenant fallback check in projects service and deny if request contains multiple org ids in result; but that's messy.
eve: prefer fixing proxy to forward x-org and also add server-side guard: require org parameter or header for internal endpoints. then canary behind flag.
ben: agree. plan: 1) patch proxy to include x-org in forwarded headers 2) add server guard (config flag OFF by default) 3) run canary for 30m on staging and then prod 5% -> 50% -> 100% 4) invalidate console cache keys for last 24h
alice: +1. any privacy incident notification needed? data exposure limited to project names; still need to notify legal.
carla: i'm on legal loop. will draft note.
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy/forwarder v2.14.3 -> rolling
ben: quick script to revoke global SA token causing cross-org view:
```
# revoke token
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://auth.internal/revoke -d '{"token":"svc-dashboard-global"}'
```
carla: can someone add telemetry alert: query results containing projects where result.org != header.x-org -> metric 'tenant_mismatch' count++
dmitri: creating alert in observability now. alert rule id: OBS-8342
eve: timeline? prefer hotfix in next 2 hours.
alice: i'm pairing with dmitri to monitor. will update here when legal note sent.
carla: thanks all. keeping thread for postmortem notes.
